comments: kuralsnet_npu_seg: the final NPU-legal segmentation model architecture (bottleneck_ch=64, /2 internal resolution, argmax-decoded segmentation head replacing the retired CenterNet heatmap+offset head -- see kurals/models/kuralsnet_npu_seg.py's module docstring for the design rationale). Best checkpoint: epoch 137, val dice 0.5144 / test dice 0.4807 (kurals_logs/KuRALS_CW/kuralsnet_npu_seg/kuralsnet_npu_seg_e300_lr0.0001_s42_0_2026-08-05-21:17:46/results/val_doppler_model.pt). Binary any-foreground vs CFAR: Prec=71.26%, Pd=56.06%, FAR=0.00%; UAV-only: Prec=56.14%, Pd=55.56% -- below baseline kuralsnet's 81.80%/94.83%, plausibly resolution-driven. A /1-resolution decoder variant (extra learned upsample hop) was tried and abandoned: it never beat this /2 checkpoint's dice under QAT and left near-zero MAC headroom (638.12M/640M). This /2 architecture is final.
